seo.title: Mobile Apps for Android and iOS
seo.description: Android and iOS apps built and published by Spectrum: TCB Card Sheba (100K+ downloads), Upokari, Novotheatre eTicket, Officers’ Club Dhaka and more.

hero.title: Mobile *apps*
hero.lead: Android and iOS apps we have built and published for government programmes, a city corporation, ministries, a members’ club, a science centre and our own Upokari products, with more than 110,000 downloads on Google Play.

sections.title: Apps people use every day
sections.lead: All of these are published by Spectrum IT Solutions Ltd. on Google Play, and three are also on the App Store.

items.name: TCB Card Sheba
items.text: For TCB dealers and authorised staff to scan, verify and activate TCB smart cards before goods are handed over. Beneficiaries can now activate their own cards too.

items.name: Upokari
items.text: A secure digital mailbox and document vault. Approved organisations send signed, QR-coded notices and invoices, and people keep their documents safe, in Bangla or English.

items.name: Novotheatre eTicket
items.text: Buy Novotheatre tickets on your phone: pick a date, choose a show such as a 5D movie, VR or the exhibits, and pay online.

items.name: Officers’ Club Dhaka
items.text: The club in members’ pockets: facilities, notices and events, hall, guest house and salon booking, dues and payments, and food ordering.

items.name: Automated Presence & Feedback
items.text: Office attendance with location and photo check-in, leave requests and balances, feedback and issue reporting, helplines and a staff directory. Used by 6 government bodies.

items.name: Upokari eCom Seller
items.text: Lets sellers on the Upokari eCom marketplace run their shop from a phone: products and stock, a point of sale, orders and a sales dashboard.

items.name: My GCC
items.text: Gazipur City Corporation’s app for holding tax and trade licences: register with NID and OTP, and see tax, assessments and dues on a dashboard.

items.name: GSB Library
items.text: The smart library app for the Geological Survey of Bangladesh (GSB), bringing its digital library services to a phone.

items.title: Android and iOS
items.text: Apps for both platforms, published and kept up to date on Google Play and the App Store.

items.title: Bangla and English
items.text: Interfaces in Bangla, English or both, so everyone can use them.

items.title: Secure sign-in
items.text: Log in with a password, PIN, fingerprint or Face ID, with data protected on the phone.

items.title: Payments
items.text: Pay dues, tickets and orders inside the app.

items.title: Scanning and verification
items.text: Scan cards and QR codes to check them on the spot, even with a weak connection.

items.title: Connected to your systems
items.text: Apps work with your website, portal and back office, so everything stays in step.

items.title: Plan
items.text: We agree who will use the app, what it must do, and how it connects to your systems.

items.title: Design
items.text: We design simple screens in Bangla and English, and test them with real users.

items.title: Build and test
items.text: We build for Android and iOS and test on the phones your users have.

items.title: Publish and support
items.text: We publish on Google Play and the App Store, and keep updating the app.

cta.title: Tell us who will use it.
cta.text: Tell us who will use it and what it must do. We will suggest the simplest way to build it for Android, iOS or both.
